name: ai-safe-earth
description: Plugins from AI SAFE EARTH: audit an AI or agent codebase for safety gaps, ordered by blast radius, price the proposed controls and apply them one approval at a time, and attest a level that a named owner signs. Hooks gate protected paths, secret literals and unsafe shell commands. Findings describe evidence, never a compliance verdict.

plugins.name: aisafe
plugins.description: Audit an AI/agent codebase for safety gaps ordered by blast radius (aisafe audit), plan and apply controls one approval at a time, and gate edits with hooks: protected paths ask, secret literals are denied, unsafe shell commands are denied, edited files are re-audited, and a Stop with a new high finding blocks once. Never a compliance verdict.
